recognize_zh: 嗜中性球核呈單一圓形或不分葉、染色質粗塊狀（假性 Pelger-Huët 樣），部分細胞核呈團塊狀、形狀怪異或碎裂樣，與秋水仙鹼造成的有絲分裂停滯相符；這些變化在停止暴露後可恢復。
features: Neutrophils with hypolobated, round to oval nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-like)
Cells with dense, irregular, clumped nuclear masses suggestive of arrested/abnormal mitoses (panels B–C)
Bizarre, irregularly fragmented or multilobed nuclear configurations in some granulocytes (panel D)
Background red cells without notable abnormality
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows granulocytes with striking nuclear abnormalities, including hypolobated round nuclei with coarse chromatin resembling pseudo-Pelger-Huet cells, cells with dense clumped chromatin masses suggestive of metaphase arrest, and bizarre irregularly segmented nuclei. Cytoplasmic granulation is preserved. Red cells are unremarkable. In the setting of Colchicum autumnale (colchicine) ingestion, findings are consistent with transient, toxin-induced antimitotic granulocyte abnormalities rather than a primary myelodysplastic process.

ddx.vs: MDS dysplasia persists and is accompanied by cytopenias, hypogranulation and clonal cytogenetics, whereas toxin-related changes resolve after exposure ends.
Inherited PHA affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with bilobed pince-nez nuclei and lacks the bizarre mitotic-arrest forms.
Morphology overlaps; drug history distinguishes them, while colchicine characteristically adds metaphase-arrested cells.
Apoptotic cells show shrinkage with multiple round smooth homogeneous nuclear spheres rather than clumped chromosome-like masses.
